title: Tool Room Head
description:
**Company Description**
SML Plastocraft Limited is a manufacturing company specializing in high-quality plastic products for a range of industrial and commercial applications. The company focuses on reliable production processes, consistent quality, and on-time delivery to meet customer expectations. Team members work in a structured environment that values safety, efficiency, and continuous improvement. SML Plastocraft Limited offers opportunities to develop technical skills and take on responsibility within its production and tooling operations. The Detroj Rampura facility is a key site for tool room and manufacturing activities.
  
**Role Description**
The Tool Room Head is a full-time, on-site role based at the Detroj Rampura facility. This role is responsible for supervising the tool room, including planning, allocating, and monitoring daily work related to molds, dies, jigs, fixtures, and other tooling. The Tool Room Head oversees preventive and corrective maintenance of tools, coordinates repairs, and ensures that tools are available and in optimal condition to support production schedules. The role involves guiding and training tool room team members, enforcing safety and quality standards, and maintaining proper documentation of tooling history, changes, and inventories. The Tool Room Head also collaborates with production, quality, and engineering teams to support new tool development, modifications, and continuous improvement in tooling performance and reliability.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong experience in tool room management, including supervision of toolmakers and technicians, work allocation, and workflow planning.
* Candidates should possess technical expertise in mold and die maintenance, repair, fitting, and assembly for plastic manufacturing or related industries.
* Candidates should possess skills in reading and interpreting engineering drawings, using tooling and measuring instruments, and maintaining tooling documentation.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of preventive maintenance practices, root cause analysis for tooling issues, and implementation of corrective actions.
* Candidates should possess strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with production, quality, and engineering teams.
* Relevant technical education such as a diploma or degree in Tool & Die Making, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior experience in a leadership role in a tool room or tooling department within a manufacturing environment is highly beneficial.
* Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement, with the ability to train and mentor team members, is expected.

title: Manager / Sr. Manager:- Raw material procurement
description:
Job Purpose

To manage strategic sourcing and procurement of raw materials for pharmaceutical formulation manufacturing, ensuring uninterrupted availability of APIs, excipients and other critical materials at competitive prices while maintaining quality standards, regulatory compliance and optimum inventory levels.

The role will be responsible for vendor development, strategic sourcing, commercial negotiations, cost optimization, supplier performance management and coordination with internal stakeholders to support production requirements.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

A. Strategic Sourcing & Procurement

* Develop and execute procurement strategies for APIs, excipients and other formulation raw materials.
* Manage end-to-end procurement activities, including sourcing, vendor identification, RFQs, price negotiations, purchase orders and delivery follow-ups.
* Ensure timely availability of raw materials in line with monthly and annual production plans.
* Develop alternate sourcing strategies to minimize supply risks and dependency on single vendors.
* Identify cost-effective procurement opportunities without compromising material quality.
* Monitor market trends, price fluctuations and raw material availability.

B. Vendor Development & Management

* Identify, evaluate and develop domestic and international suppliers for APIs and excipients.
* Coordinate with QA and QC teams for vendor qualification, material evaluation and approval.
* Conduct supplier performance reviews based on quality, cost, delivery and service parameters.
* Develop long-term strategic relationships with key suppliers.
* Ensure availability of approved vendors for critical and high-consumption materials.
* Drive supplier improvement initiatives and resolve recurring supply-related issues.

C. Cost Optimization & Commercial Negotiations

* Lead price negotiations, annual rate contracts and commercial agreements with suppliers.
* Drive cost reduction through strategic sourcing, bulk procurement and alternate vendor development.
* Benchmark material prices against market trends and industry standards.
* Monitor foreign exchange fluctuations, import duties, freight and other procurement-related costs.
* Identify opportunities for value engineering and procurement savings.
* Ensure adherence to approved budgets and procurement policies.

D. Production Planning & Inventory Management

* Coordinate with Production Planning, SCM and Manufacturing teams to ensure uninterrupted raw material availability.
* Monitor material requirements based on production schedules and demand forecasts.
* Maintain optimum inventory levels while minimizing excess and non-moving stock.
* Track purchase order ageing, material lead times and delivery commitments.
* Ensure timely resolution of shortages and critical material procurement issues.
* Develop contingency plans for long-lead-time and critical raw materials.

E. Quality & Regulatory Compliance

* Ensure procurement is restricted to approved and qualified vendors.
* Coordinate with QA/QC for material specifications, COA verification, sampling and quality approvals.
* Ensure compliance with applicable GMP requirements and internal quality procedures.
* Support vendor audits and supplier qualification activities.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of procurement transactions.
* Address quality-related supplier complaints and coordinate corrective actions.

F. Import Procurement & Supply Chain Coordination

* Manage import procurement of APIs and excipients wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with international suppliers, logistics partners, customs and finance teams.
* Monitor import lead times, shipment schedules and documentation.
* Ensure compliance with applicable import regulations and company policies.
* Develop risk mitigation strategies for global supply disruptions.

G. ERP & Procurement MIS

* Ensure accurate procurement transactions and documentation in SAP/ERP systems.
* Monitor purchase requisitions, purchase orders, pending deliveries and material ageing.
* Prepare periodic procurement MIS covering savings, vendor performance, purchase price variance and material availability.
* Track procurement KPIs and provide regular updates to management.

H. Team Leadership

* Lead and develop the raw material procurement team.
* Establish procurement objectives and performance metrics.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
* Develop negotiation capabilities and sourcing expertise within the team.
* Drive process improvements and procurement excellence.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Material availability

Zero production loss due to procurement-related shortages

Cost optimization

Annual procurement savings

Vendor development

New qualified vendors developed

Purchase efficiency

PR-to-PO turnaround time

Delivery performance

On-time delivery from suppliers

Inventory management

Inventory ageing and working capital optimization

Quality compliance

Procurement from approved vendors

Supplier performance

Vendor quality and delivery ratings

ERP discipline

Accuracy of procurement data and MIS

4. Professional Qualifications

* B.Pharm / M.Pharm preferred.
* B.Sc. / M.Sc. Chemistry or B.Tech / B.E. Chemical Engineering may also be considered.
* MBA / PGDM in Supply Chain Management or Materials Management will be an added advantage.

5. Experience

* 12–18 years of experience in procurement and strategic sourcing within the pharmaceutical formulations industry.
* Strong experience in sourcing APIs, excipients and formulation raw materials.
* Experience in domestic and international vendor development.
* Proven track record in commercial negotiations and cost optimization.
* Good understanding of pharmaceutical quality requirements and supplier qualification processes.
* Experience working on SAP/ERP procurement modules.

**Designation: Manager - Cutting**

**Department: Cutting & Sorting**

**Location: Gandhinagar**

**About the Role**

To manage the complete throughput of the Cutting Department — including cutting machines, manual cutting, and the sorting team — by ensuring high people productivity, optimal machine efficiency, minimal fabric and foam wastage, timely order execution based on ageing, accurate cut-kit dispatch to vendors, and error-free cutting and sorting to eliminate kit returns.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Throughput & Productivity Management**

* Own end-to-end throughput of all cutting machines and the sorting team.
* Monitor and drive machine efficiency (OEE) and operator productivity on a daily/shift basis.
* Track output vs. plan for cutting and sorting; identify and resolve bottlenecks in real time.
* Set and review productivity benchmarks (pieces/hour, kits/day, machine utilization %) for operators and machines.

**2. Cutting Operations (Fabric, Foam & Manual)**

* Plan and supervise fabric cutting, foam cutting, and manual cutting operations.
* Deploy manual cutting judiciously for small-scale/low-volume requirements to optimize material usage and reduce wastage.
* Continuously identify opportunities to reduce fabric and foam wastage through better marker planning, lay optimization, and cutting sequence.
* Ensure correct cutting specifications, patterns, and sizes are followed as per order requirements.

**3. Order Prioritization & Scheduling**

* Track ageing of all pending orders and use ageing data to prioritize the daily/weekly cutting schedule.
* Prepare and maintain a cutting schedule/plan aligned with dispatch commitments and order priority.
* Coordinate with planning, merchandising, and production teams to align cutting schedules with overall production flow.

**4. Sorting & Kit Management**

* Supervise the sorting team to ensure accurate sorting and kitting of cut components.
* Ensure cut kits are complete, correctly matched, and free of defects before dispatch.
* Ensure cutting and sorting processes are executed error-free to eliminate kit returns from vendors/downstream units.

**5. Vendor Kit Distribution**

* Ensure cut kits are distributed to vendors strictly as per the agreed dispatch plan and timelines.
* Maintain proper documentation and records of kits dispatched — including quantity, date, vendor, and order reference.
* Coordinate with logistics/dispatch teams to ensure timely and accurate handover of kits.
* Track and resolve any discrepancies or delays in kit distribution.

**6. Quality & Wastage Control**

* Implement checks/controls to minimize cutting errors, mismatches, and material wastage.
* Conduct root-cause analysis on kit returns or cutting errors and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce rework, wastage %, and kit rejection rate.

**7. Team Management**

* Lead, train, and manage cutting machine operators, manual cutters, and the sorting team.
* Plan manpower deployment/shift allocation based on order load and machine availability.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, and performance of the team; conduct performance reviews.
* Identify training needs and build a skilled, multi-tasking workforce.

**8. Records & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of cutting output, wastage, machine efficiency, kit dispatch, and returns.
* Prepare and share daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports with management on department performance.
* Ensure documentation is audit-ready and compliant with internal SOPs.

**9. Machine & Resource Management**

* Ensure preventive maintenance of cutting machines is planned and executed to avoid downtime.
* Coordinate with maintenance team for timely breakdown resolution.
* Monitor machine efficiency and take corrective action for underperforming equipment.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**

* Cutting & sorting throughput vs. plan
* Machine efficiency / OEE %
* Fabric & foam wastage %
* On-time cut-kit dispatch to vendors (%)
* Kit return rate (target: zero/near-zero)
* Order ageing compliance in scheduling
* Team productivity and attendance
* Accuracy of dispatch and production records

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate in Textile/Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or related field (relevant experience may be considered in lieu).
* 5–10 years of experience in cutting department operations within furniture, mattress, upholstery, garment, or foam-based manufacturing.
* Proven experience managing cutting machines (fabric/foam) and sorting/kitting teams.
* Hands-on exposure to manual cutting operations is preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of fabric and foam cutting processes and wastage optimization techniques.
* Good planning and scheduling skills, especially order-ageing-based prioritization.
* People management and team leadership skills.
* Data-driven approach — comfortable maintaining records/MIS in Excel or ERP systems.
* Strong coordination skills with planning, merchandising, dispatch, and vendor teams.
* Problem-solving mindset with focus on quality and error elimination.
* Attention to detail and process discipline.

This position owns the commercial relationship with every carrier the business uses — rate negotiation, lane allocation, contract renewal and freight cost assurance. The role carries a monthly express freight spend running in the order of 23 crore, against which no contracted rate table currently exists for the India entities.

* Monitor volume commitments and surge clauses against contractual thresholds, and flag a breach before the carrier does.
* Run carrier governance — quarterly business reviews, SLA reviews, escalation matrices and service remedies.
* Report carrier cost monthly into the business review and into the gross margin programme.
* Support the trade and customs compliance function on carrier-side documentation, without owning compliance itself.

* Deep working knowledge of express pricing mechanics — dimensional divisors, fuel tables, accessorial structures, zone and lane pricing, earned discount tiers and volume commitments.
* Freight audit and recovery experience, including building and defending a claim against a carrier.

* Able to hold a senior carrier relationship and a difficult commercial conversation without damaging it.
* Graduate. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain, or CIPS or equivalent procurement certification, an advantage.

* A complete rate card and contract baseline across every carrier, in one register.
* A renewal and expiry calendar with a named owner against each date, including the February 2027 surcharge cliff.
* The open recovery claim either closed or on an agreed, dated path with the carrier.
* Lane allocation logic documented and agreed with operations.
* A first view of accessorial spend by type, with the three largest reduction opportunities quantified.

**Inventory management**

* Lead inventory optimisation initiatives without compromising service levels.

+ Implement hourly production tracking boards – with BPM Team.
+ Introduce Poka-Yoke / mistake-proofing where scrap or quality leakage is systemic rather than one-off.

+ Partner with MDM Team for BOM Preparation for Time Measurement (Crue member size/labour/machine).
+ Partner with the Manager, Global Capacity to feed validated IE process-time data into the Capacity vs Demand model and the monthly Capacity Governance Review.

+ Prior exposure to apparel, soft-furnishing, furniture or comparable multi-SKU manufacturing is preferred, across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines.
+ Working proficiency in Excel and, ideally, Power BI, for data-driven decisions.

**Skills & Competencies**




+ Senior stakeholder management — comfortable presenting to and being evaluated.
+ People leadership across multiple, physically dispersed teams and areas.
+ Analytical rigor balanced with pragmatic, shop-floor-first problem solving.
+ Structured change management — able to introduce new standards without disrupting live production.
+ Clear written and verbal communication for cross-functional coordination with MDM, Global Capacity and Automation.

+ BOM Preparation for Time Measurement (Crue member size / labour / machine calculation) – SKU wise

+ On-time delivery of hourly production tracking board roll-out.

title: Manager - Process Excellence & Cost Optimization
description:
**Job Purpose**
This role controls plant cost and material loss and improves workforce productivity. It does this through standard measurement systems (BOM, cost per sq ft, manpower matrices) and shop-floor automation such as production scanning, smart scheduling and live dashboards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cost and Financial Control**

* Track monthly plant cost per sq ft against budget, and analyse and explain variances.
* Reconcile BB and COV material consumption and wastage against BOM, keeping variance within 1%.
* Build and maintain a BOM-based tracking system for general consumables, with cost variance within 5%.
* Reconcile and approve job-worker bills within the agreed billing cycle, with no delays.

**Automation and Digital Tracking**

* Implement operator-wise and team-wise production scanning (barcode for COV, QR code for BB) to measure throughput and reduce manpower cost by 10% YoY.
* Drive smart production scheduling and order-kit allocation to improve direct-worker efficiency by 20%.
* Develop an AI / Power BI tracker for media-wise material inflow versus wastage, with full traceability and variance under 1%.
* Maintain daily plant and department dashboards comparing budget and actual cost trends.

**Waste Management and Manpower Productivity**

* Develop at least two alternate or backup buyers for each saleable scrap item or category, targeting a 15% impact on sale value.
* Optimise waste disposal, including balers for cardboard, plastic and fabric, to cut waste volume by 30%.
* Build a manpower performance measurement matrix for non-sq-ft production and non-production departments.
* Support the skill matrix and skill-based operator allocation, and train supervisors and operators in method and productivity improvement (10 people per department).

**General Duties**

* Conduct time and motion studies, set standard times, and balance lines.
* Prepare monthly MIS and variance reports for management.
* Coordinate with production, stores, finance, IT and vendors.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen and 5S initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Industrial, Mechanical or Production Engineering. An MBA or PGDIE is preferred.
* 8–12 years in manufacturing industrial engineering, costing or productivity, including at least 3 years leading projects or a team.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong in BOM and inventory reconciliation, cost analysis, time study and production scheduling.
* Skilled in advanced Excel and Power BI, with exposure to ERP/MES and barcode or QR systems. AI or analytics knowledge is a plus.
* Analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable presenting data to senior management.
* Able to work across departments and train shop-floor teams.

**Role Purpose** 





 MOBA India is looking for an experienced Quality Manager to build and lead the quality function from the ground up. This role is not limited to end\-of\-line inspection; it requires establishing a structured Quality Management System, introducing Total Quality Management practices, building quality processes and documentation, leading internal audits, and embedding quality across incoming, in\-process, final inspection, supplier quality, customer quality, and continuous improvement activities in line with standard manufacturing expectations.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**·** 

 Build, implement, and continuously improve the company Quality Management System covering process definition, documentation, control, compliance, and governance.
 




**·** 

 Develop quality foundation documents including SOPs, inspection standards, process maps, quality control plans, check sheets, work instructions, nonconformity handling formats, CAPA systems, deviation control, and controlled records.
 




**·** 

 Move the organization beyond end\-of\-line inspection by introducing incoming quality control, in\-process quality checks, stage\-wise inspection criteria, process audits, and structured quality feedback loops with production and engineering.
 




**·** 

 Deploy practical quality tools such as Control Plan, PFMEA, APQP, PPAP, SPC, MSA, 8D, root cause analysis, and corrective/preventive action systems as relevant to OEM\-facing manufacturing.
 




**·** 

 Lead internal audits, support customer audits, prepare the organization for external certification or compliance reviews, and drive closure of audit findings across functions.
 




**·** 

 Establish quality KPIs such as rejection ppm, first pass yield, rework, supplier defects, field failures, customer complaints, warranty trends, and CAPA closure effectiveness, with regular reporting to management.
 




**·** 

 Work closely with Production, Stores, SCM, Engineering, Service, and Management to ensure quality is built into processes rather than checked only at dispatch.
 




**·** 

 Develop supplier quality practices including supplier qualification support, incoming inspection standards, supplier corrective action, and supplier performance monitoring.
 




**·** 

 Ensure calibration planning, measurement system discipline, traceability, and controlled use of gauges, fixtures, and testing equipment.
 




**·** 

 Build organization\-wide quality awareness through training, documentation discipline, audit readiness, and practical implementation of standard quality practices on the shop floor.
 




  





**Candidate Profile** 




**·** 

 Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial, Production, or related engineering discipline; master’s degree preferred.
 




**·** 

 7–10 years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, preferably in industrial electronics, automotive components, off\-highway equipment, or OEM\-facing manufacturing environments.
 




**·** 

 Proven experience in setting up or significantly strengthening a quality system from scratch, not only managing final inspection activities.
 




**·** 

 Strong hands\-on knowledge of ISO 9001 and practical implementation of process\-based QMS in manufacturing.
 




**·** 

 Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, Control Plan, FMEA, SPC, MSA, CAPA, NCR, 8D, and internal audit systems.
 




**·** 

 Experience in handling customer quality expectations, audit preparation, and closure of nonconformities through cross\-functional coordination.
 




**·** 

 Strong leadership, communication, documentation, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
 




  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




**·** 

 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor qualification in ISO 9001 preferred.
 




**·** 

 Exposure to IATF 16949\-style core tools or similar OEM quality expectations is highly desirable.
 




**·** 

 Experience in electronics assembly, rugged industrial products, or low\-to\-medium volume OEM supply environments is an added advantage.
